$comment: OPT-IN HOOK: Codex gates plugin-bundled hooks behind [features].plugin_hooks = true in ~/.codex/config.toml.
Without that flag, this file is inert. Enable it then reinstall the plugin to activate.
What it does: when the Codex agent finishes a turn (Stop event), the script
checks if this session is in listener mode (has a marker file written by /listen).
If so, it asks agent-bus poll-inbox to decide whether to keep the agent in the
inbox loop (returning a Stop-hook block decision) or let control return to the user.
- no-op if agent-bus CLI is not installed
- no-op if no listener marker exists for this session
- no-op if stop_hook_active is already true (loop guard)
If you DO NOT want listener resilience via this hook, leave [features].plugin_hooks
disabled (default). Listener mode still works fine via the long-blocking
